decision: ADR-020 §3 (scheduler decision 2026-10-09): Action definitions NexLoop itself needs are published at deployment through trusted configuration (0050), compiled from this versioned declaration; never constructed ad hoc and never written to definition tables directly. Human-owner Actions (authority human_owner) are granted to the owner's human principal, never to service principals. v4 (dispatcher ruling 2026-10-10, NX-050): the service ontology.object.edit Capability profile, declared through Consumer.edit:1 (executed by claim_matcher, whose grant is already in service-grants). Review-approved new types reuse the tenant's published ontology.object.create / ontology.object.edit snapshots for their <Type>.create / <Type>.edit (0101); a capability definition, not a grant. v5 (NX-026): Commitment.create / Commitment.edit, executed by commitment_keeper (the edit is constrained in SQL to the transition derived from the evidence ledger, 0111), and five human-owner commitment Actions (cancel, extend, attest, condition met, mark as communication commitment) through the NX-022 governed entry; SQL refuses services and Agents even with a grant. v6 (NX-027): CommercialRecord.create / CommercialRecord.edit, executed only by commercial_recorder. v7 (NX-027): CommercialRecord.observe, the human owner's read of commercial records, costs and key results (0134). v8 (NX-028 slices 2–3, one version on top of NX-027 v7): slice 2 (D7/D9), two human requests through the governed entry's capability registry (0150): nexloop.plan.request_reevaluation (marks one active plan due now; precheck still decides) and nexloop.service.query_request (brings an unknown effect forward for the executor's one QUERY; nothing is resent). Typed on Consumer v1, the business object they concern. Slice 3 (D3–D5): nexloop.conversation.takeover / nexloop.conversation.handback, human only, typed on Consumer v1 (0152). Slice 3 (dispatcher ruling B): nexloop.message.staff_send — a staff reply written by the author of the active takeover directly into a native WebChat conversation (no effect ledger), bound to one inbound message, under ADR-023 §2.6/§2.7 like any reply (0153). v9 (NX-027, on the NX-028 registry 0124): nexloop.commitment.bind_commercial and nexloop.cost.record, human only, registered in 0140 (handlers 0121 / 0120).

actions.purpose: Governed formal Consumer property write of an accepted Claim match (NX-020); also publishes the tenant's ontology.object.edit Capability snapshot that review-approved new types reuse for <Type>.edit (NX-044/NX-050). Object and property EDIT are still decided per object.
Create the Message object of an Agent reply after the channel accepted it (NX-047); content, sender, conversation and delivery state come from the governed outbound record, never from the caller.
Publish the next immutable version of a Context strategy (budgets, quotas, trim order). Human owner only; SQL refuses services and Agents even with a grant (NX-023).

Read one model-call Manifest (sources, versions, request digest). Humans only (owner / audit role, owner decision 2026-10-09); SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant; never in service-grants (NX-023).
Create the Commitment object of an enterprise commitment Claim from a delivered outbound Message (or a human extension); SQL accepts only the properties prepared from that evidence (0111).
Apply the status transition SQL derives from the evidence ledger (in progress, fulfilled, breached, cancelled, communication basis); any other edit is refused (0111).
Cancel an open, conditional or in-progress commitment with a reason (never a breached one). Human owner only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-026).
Governed extension: a new Commitment with the new due date supersedes the old one; the old one is kept. Human owner only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-026).
Human attestation of fulfilment (qualifying evidence) with a reason and the time it happened. Human owner only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-026).
Record that the condition of a conditional commitment is met (v0.1: humans only, D4). Human owner only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-026).

Mark one commitment as a communication commitment: delivered messages bound to it afterwards are qualifying evidence (D3). Human owner only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-026).
Create the CommercialRecord of a verified signed commercial event; SQL accepts only the state derived from the record's verified events (0130).
Apply the state SQL derives from all verified events of the record, its refunds and its customer link (corrections, late events, refunds, D6 pseudonymization); any other edit is refused (0130).

Read commercial records, costs and settlements, and key results (D09 GET /commercial-observations, /costs, /metrics); human owner only, SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials before any grant (0134).

Ask for one reevaluation of an active plan now (cause human); the NX-024 precheck still decides whether a bounded Run starts. Human only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-028).

Ask the executor service to query the result of an unknown or query-pending effect now (D7); never a resend, never a new idempotency key; the human holds no reconcile Action. Human only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-028).

A person takes over one conversation or one consumer for a bounded time (default 2 h, at most 24 h); the Agent does not reply meanwhile. Human only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-028).

Hand a takeover back: the latest unanswered message returns to normal handling, earlier ones are recorded as settled, plans are reevaluated. Human only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-028).

A person who took the conversation over replies to one inbound message (native WebChat only; an external channel needs the effect ledger, design A). Human only; SQL refuses services, Agents and Run credentials even with a grant (NX-028).

Bind a commitment to one commercial reference (connector, kind, external id); only verified signed events of that reference become its commercial_event evidence, and only for the commitment's own Consumer. Human only through the governed entry registry (0121 handler, 0140 row).

Enter a service or labour cost (operator_entered) or correct an earlier one by supersession; never rewritten, never added across currencies. Human only through the governed entry registry (0120 handler, 0140 row).
